items.known: CKV_AWS_5 Ensure all data stored in the Elasticsearch is securely encrypted at rest (resource aws_elasticsearch_domain.monitoring-framework)
items.remediation: Add an `encrypt_at_rest` block: `encrypt_at_rest { enabled = true }`. Optionally specify a KMS key via `kms_key_id`.

items.known: CKV_AWS_84 Ensure Elasticsearch Domain Logging is enabled (resource aws_elasticsearch_domain.monitoring-framework)
items.issue: Audit Logging / CloudWatch Log Publishing Not Enabled
items.remediation: Add one or more `log_publishing_options` blocks, e.g.: `log_publishing_options { log_type = "AUDIT_LOGS" cloudwatch_log_group_arn = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.es_logs.arn }`. Also enable `INDEX_SLOW_LOGS` and `SEARCH_SLOW_LOGS` as needed.

scores.reason: Correctly specifies the aws_elasticsearch_domain encrypt_at_rest block with enabled = true; kms_key_id optional.
Correctly identifies adding log_publishing_options on the domain with log_type and cloudwatch_log_group_arn to enable logging.
